description: How offers moved through the pipeline: the funnel stages with how many each removed, and the application lanes. Pass an analytics section ('intake', 'market', 'scores', 'applications', 'runs') to get that slice of the full analytics view instead.

section.description: One of intake, market, scores, applications, runs. Omit for the funnel and lanes overview.

name: leadgen_funnel_stats
title: leadgen_funnel_stats

description: Fetch one offer by id with its full detail: description, score reasons, flags and sources. Set includeFullText to get the complete advert text as well, which is large.

includeFullText.description: Include the complete advert text. Default false, because it is long.

name: leadgen_get_offer
title: leadgen_get_offer

description: The configuration that decides what survives and how it is scored: matching rules with weights, penalties and knockouts; the scoring models; the configured sources; or the prompts.

section.description: One of rules, scoring-models, sources, prompts.

name: leadgen_get_pipeline_config
title: leadgen_get_pipeline_config

description: The last completed ingest run and the one in flight, if any: per-source counts, what each filter removed, and how many reached the shortlist. Each stage row carries its status and duration; an OK stage that worked on several adverts at once also carries `width` and the note `width=N`, which is how wide it ran, not an error.
name: leadgen_ingest_status
title: leadgen_ingest_status

description: The application board: every offer that moved past the shortlist, with its status, lane, score and whether a package was built for it. Note that the package itself is a zip download from leadgen's own UI and is deliberately not reachable through this server.

status.description: Only applications in this status, e.g. 'APPLIED'. Omit for all.

name: leadgen_list_applications
title: leadgen_list_applications

description: Search the leadgen shortlist of freelance project offers. Returns compact summaries (title, agency, portal, location, remote share, duration, rate, score, tags, url) — not the advert text. Use leadgen_get_offer for the full advert of one offer. Results are capped; the response always reports how many matched in total and carries a nextCursor when more exist.

band.description: Score band, e.g. 'high'. Cannot be combined with minScore/maxScore.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's nextCursor.

deadlineOpen.description: Only offers whose application deadline has not passed.

q.description: Free-text search over title, description and tags.

semantic.description: Semantic search phrase. Ranks by meaning rather than keyword; cannot be combined with similarToOfferId.

similarToOfferId.description: Find offers similar to this offer id.

sort.description: Sort key as leadgen defines it, e.g. 'score'.

name: leadgen_search_offers
title: leadgen_search_offers

name: leadgen_application
title: leadgen_application
description: The application for one offer: its status, every status change newest first, dates, the note, and the cover letter's text if one was written. Look it up by the offer's id, as leadgen_search_offers returns it.

offerId.description: The offer's id, as the other tools return it.

name: leadgen_profile
title: leadgen_profile
description: The skill profile in force: roles, seniority, skills by tier with weights, industries, the topics that lift or sink a score, the reference projects a cover letter may cite, and languages.

name: leadgen_semantic_search
title: leadgen_semantic_search
description: Finds offers whose advert is closest in meaning to the given words, nearest first, across the working shortlist and the archive; each offer says whether it is archived. Use it for 'anything like ...' questions and leadgen_search_offers for filters and counts. When 'unavailable' is set this installation cannot search by meaning.

query.description: What the offers should be about, in a few words, e.g. 'event streaming with Kafka'.

name: leadgen_statistics
title: leadgen_statistics
description: The numbers the dashboard and analytics screens show: the filter funnel, offers per day, pipeline runs per day, the score histogram and bands, applications per status with reply times, the last run, the market, the knockouts per day and stage, and the scoring scales in use. 'from' and 'to' narrow only the per-day series; the result says which days were covered. With 'compareFrom' and 'compareTo' it also carries 'comparison' and 'differences', this window's totals minus the comparison's.

from.description: First day to include, as YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: Last day to include, as YYYY-MM-DD.

compareFrom.description: First day of a window to compare with, as YYYY-MM-DD.

compareTo.description: Last day of a window to compare with, as YYYY-MM-DD.
